description: `POST /api/dispatch/assignments` had no idempotency protection. Concurrent same-key retries could create duplicate dispatch assignments · duplicate SMS scheduling · duplicate notification fanout · duplicate audit rows. Same defect existed on Roll-Off variant (canonical model uses same handler with haul_type='Roll-Off').
fix: Wrapped create_assignment body (lines 1099-1315) in `_do_create` closure and called `with_idempotency(db · key · actor · _do_create · workflow=\"dispatch_assignment\")` at the end. Motive posture reads and stale-Motive ribbon logic remain OUTSIDE the factory (untouched). SMS scheduling · notification fanout · Trust Spine emit · dispatch board update — all inside the factory · exactly-once by construction.

description: The reservation-lock poll window (10s at 250ms) was too tight for handlers with heavy fan-out — dispatch's create_assignment does SMS scheduling + notification + Trust Spine + board update which can exceed 10s under load. Losers timed out and fell through to the factory-fallback path · potentially creating duplicates.
fix: Bumped poll window from 40 iterations to 120 iterations (~30s total at 250ms cadence). Stale-sentinel reclaim at 90s remains unchanged.
